name: ARC (AI2 Reasoning Challenge)
intro: ARC（AI2推理挑战）包含7,787道为3–9年级人类考试命制的自然、无图表科学选择题。Waterloo语料检索求解器与PMI词共现求解器均答错的2,590题组成Challenge集，其余5,197题组成Easy集；项目同时发布1400万科学句子的ARC Corpus和公开基线。
build_method: 公版科学考试题收集, IR+PMI双失败难度筛选, 语料库构建
metric: 选择题准确率；求解器并列选择时按比例给分
eval_feature: 自然科学问答, 算法难度门禁, Easy/Challenge双集, 公开语料与基线
build_method_en: Public-domain science exam collection, IR-plus-PMI dual-failure filtering, corpus construction
eval_feature_en: Natural science QA, algorithmic difficulty gate, Easy/Challenge sets, public corpus and baselines
intro_en: ARC (AI2 Reasoning Challenge) contains 7,787 natural, non-diagram multiple-choice science questions authored for human tests in grades 3-9. The 2,590 questions missed by both a Waterloo-corpus retrieval solver and a PMI word-co-occurrence solver form the Challenge Set; the remaining 5,197 form Easy. ARC also releases a 14-million-sentence science corpus and public baselines.
metric_en: Multiple-choice accuracy; fractional credit for tied solver selections
drawio_review_note: REDRAW reviewed against arXiv:1803.05457v1 Dataset, Identifying Challenge, and Corpus sections. The diagram runs the Waterloo IR and PMI solvers in parallel, labels the both-wrong versus otherwise branches, and builds the independent corpus lane from roughly 100 templates for 80 topics through web retrieval, deduplication, text extraction, sentence splitting, and addition of AristoMini into 14M sentences. The ARC Corpus is shown only as an optional retrieval resource, never as a dataset-derived stage.
